# judo-ng docs, specs and indexes that contradict the code

For the judo-ng developers. Each row is a statement in a judo-ng repository (README, module doc, OpenSpec spec, AGENTS index) that the code does not match, or a spec requirement the code does not meet. Found by the full judo-ng read (2,864 findings) and validated against the code; duplicates are listed once. The catalog documents platform behaviour for application developers; this list is about judo-ng's own documentation and specs.

Rows: 2819 (doc 1390, bug 1185, dox 244) in 100 repositories. Read on 2026-11-04 (commit in each evidence column); the worktrees in `target/judo-ng-read/wt/` were updated to the latest `develop` on 2026-11-19, so some rows may be fixed since. Full source: `reports/research/judo-ng-read/findings.md`.

Kinds: `doc` = a doc or spec statement the code contradicts (statement / what the code does); `bug` = a spec-vs-code defect (what / expected); `dox` = an AGENTS index row the code contradicts.
